questions.stem: 看到明星完美的照片，連年輕人也開始購買抗老產品（anti-aging products），這讓抗老產業蓬勃發展。
questions.answer: Seeing perfect photos of celebrities, even young people have started buying anti-aging products, which has caused the anti-aging industry to boom.
accepted_answers: Seeing perfect pictures of stars, even young people have begun to buy anti-aging products, which has made the anti-aging industry boom.
Having seen perfect photos of celebrities, even young people have started buying anti-aging products, which has led to a boom in the anti-aging industry.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which 指前面整句）

questions.stem: 擔心自己顯老，許多消費者花大錢買這些產品，卻從不想想它們是否真的有效。
questions.answer: Worried about looking old, many consumers spend a fortune on these products but never think about whether they really work.
accepted_answers: Worried that they look old, many consumers spend a lot of money on these products without ever asking whether they are truly effective.
Worrying about looking old, many consumers spend large sums of money on these products but never consider whether they actually work.

patterns: 間接問句（whether 名詞子句）

1.explanation_zh: 「看到明星完美的照片」沒有主詞，做這個動作的其實是後面的「年輕人」，所以用分詞構句 Seeing …, even young people …。「連…也」用 even 放在名詞前；「開始購買」用現在完成式 have started buying 表示到現在的趨勢。「這讓…」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which has caused／made …（which 指整個子句）；made 後面接原形 boom，caused 後面接 to boom。
evidence: 這讓抗老產業蓬勃發展
1.strategy_zh: 句首沒有主詞的動作（看到…、聽到…）→ 先想分詞構句 V-ing …；「…，這讓／這使得…」→ , which + V …（which 指前面整句）。
hints: 切成四段：看到明星完美的照片／連年輕人也開始購買抗老產品／這讓／抗老產業蓬勃發展
標的詞彙：see（看到）、perfect（完美的）、photo（照片）、celebrity（明星）、young（年輕的）、buy（購買）、industry（產業）、boom（蓬勃發展）
句型框架：V-ing …, even + S + have started V-ing …, which has caused + O + to V

2.explanation_zh: 「擔心自己顯老」是後面「許多消費者」的心理狀態，用過去分詞開頭的分詞構句 Worried about looking old,（＝Because they are worried about looking old）；about 後面接動名詞。「花大錢買…」用 spend a fortune／a lot of money on …。「是否真的有效」是 think about 的受詞，用 whether 引導的名詞子句，語序是 whether + they + really work（直述句）；「有效」可用動詞 work 或形容詞 effective。
2.strategy_zh: 「是否…」當受詞 → whether + S + V（不倒裝）；「花錢在…上」→ spend + 錢 + on + N。
hints: 切成四段：擔心自己顯老／許多消費者花大錢買這些產品／卻從不想想／它們是否真的有效
標的詞彙：worry（擔心）、old（老的）、consumer（消費者）、spend（花錢）、fortune（大筆錢）、product（產品）、think（想）、work（有效）
句型框架：Worried about V-ing …, S + spend a fortune on … but never think about whether + S + V

references: Seeing perfect photos of celebrities, even young people have started buying anti-aging products, which has caused the anti-aging industry to boom.
Seeing perfect pictures of stars, even young people have begun to buy anti-aging products, which has made the anti-aging industry boom.
Having seen perfect photos of celebrities, even young people have started buying anti-aging products, which has led to a boom in the anti-aging industry.

patterns.label_zh: 分詞構句：句首 V-ing 片語（看到…）
非限定關係子句：which 指前面整句（這讓…）
patterns.frame: S + V …, which has caused + O + to V ／ which has made + O + V
patterns.zh_trigger: 這讓抗老產業蓬勃發展

accepted: Having seen perfect photos of celebrities

common_errors.wrong: See perfect photos of celebrities, even young people
common_errors.right: Seeing perfect photos of celebrities, even young people
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「看到…」沒有主詞，英文不能用原形動詞 See 開頭又接主要子句（兩個動詞沒有連接）；改成分詞構句 Seeing …，邏輯主詞就是後面的 young people。
「明星」泛指一群人，用複數 celebrities（或 stars）。

parts.zh: 連年輕人也開始購買抗老產品
accepted: even young people have started buying anti-aging products
even young people have begun to buy anti-aging products
even young people have started to buy anti-aging products
even young people have begun buying anti-aging products

common_errors.wrong: even young people also have started buying
common_errors.right: even young people have started buying
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「連…也」用 even 就夠了，再加 also 是贅字。

common_errors.wrong: even young people have started buy
common_errors.right: even young people have started buying
common_errors.explanation_zh: start／begin 後面接動名詞 buying 或不定詞 to buy，不能接原形動詞。
「這讓…」的「這」指前面整件事，英文用非限定關係代名詞 which；寫成 this 會讓兩個完整句子只用逗號相連（逗號連接句）。
逗號後面補充說明前面整句，只能用 which，that 不用在非限定關係子句。

accepted: a boom in the anti-aging industry

common_errors.wrong: which has made the anti-aging industry to boom
common_errors.right: which has made the anti-aging industry boom
common_errors.explanation_zh: 使役動詞 make 後面接原形動詞 boom，不加 to；cause 才接 to boom。
「蓬勃發展」不要逐字拆成 develop prosperously，英文一個動詞 boom（或名詞 a boom in …）就能表達。

traps.literal_error: See perfect photos of celebrities, even young people have started buying …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文句首「看到…」省略主詞，英文不能讓原形動詞開頭又接另一個子句；改用分詞構句 Seeing …（邏輯主詞＝後面的 young people）。

traps.literal_error: …, which makes the anti-aging industry develop prosperously.
traps.explanation_zh: 「蓬勃發展」是複合概念，照字面拆成 develop + prosperously 很不自然；英文用動詞 boom（迅速興旺）或名詞 a boom in …。

bonus.text: So perfect do celebrities look in their photos that even young people have started buying anti-aging products, fueling a boom in the industry.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + 形容詞 + 助動詞 + 主詞 … that …（倒裝）強調「明星看起來完美到…」；句尾 fueling a boom in … 用分詞表結果。倒裝只是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「這讓抗老產業蓬勃發展」的「這」指前面整件事，英文不另起一句用 this，而是改成非限定關係子句 , which has caused …；「蓬勃發展」也可以名詞化成 a boom in the anti-aging industry。

references: Worried about looking old, many consumers spend a fortune on these products but never think about whether they really work.
Worried that they look old, many consumers spend a lot of money on these products without ever asking whether they are truly effective.
Worrying about looking old, many consumers spend large sums of money on these products but never consider whether they actually work.

patterns.label_zh: 分詞構句：句首過去分詞片語（擔心…）
間接問句：whether 名詞子句（是否…）
patterns.frame: … think about + whether + S + V（直述句語序）

common_errors.wrong: Worry about looking old, many consumers
common_errors.right: Worried about looking old, many consumers
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「擔心…」沒有主詞，英文不能用原形 Worry 開頭再接主要子句；改成分詞構句 Worried about …（＝Because they are worried about …）。
介系詞 about 後面接動名詞 looking。

parts.zh: 許多消費者花大錢買這些產品
accepted: many consumers spend a fortune on these products
many consumers spend a lot of money on these products
many consumers spend large sums of money on these products

common_errors.wrong: many consumers spend big money on these products
common_errors.right: many consumers spend a fortune on these products
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「花大錢」不是 big money，要說 a fortune、a lot of money 或 large sums of money。

common_errors.wrong: many consumer spend a fortune on these products
common_errors.right: many consumers spend a fortune on these products
common_errors.explanation_zh: many 後面接複數名詞 consumers。

accepted: but never stop to think about

common_errors.explanation_zh: 主詞 many consumers 是複數，動詞 think 不加 s。
介系詞 without 後面接動名詞 asking。
間接問句用直述句語序（whether + 主詞 + 動詞），不加疑問句的 do。
work（有效）本身是動詞，前面不加 are；用形容詞才寫 are effective。

traps.literal_error: Worry about look old, many consumers spend …
traps.explanation_zh: 句首的「擔心」沒有主詞，英文要變成分詞 Worried／Worrying，不能用原形動詞開頭；「顯老」是 look old，about 後面要用動名詞 looking。

traps.literal_error: many consumers spend big money to buy these products
traps.explanation_zh: 「花大錢」英文是 spend a fortune／a lot of money on …；big money 是逐字直譯，spend 的錢後面用 on + 東西。

bonus.text: Worried about looking old, many consumers pour money into these products; rarely do they stop to ask whether the products really work.
bonus.explanation_zh: pour money into …（把錢大把砸進…）是生動的搭配；否定副詞 rarely 放句首要倒裝（do + 主詞 + 原形動詞）。倒裝只是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「卻從不想想…」可以改用介系詞片語 without ever asking whether …，把兩個動作併進同一個子句。

1.translation: Seeing the perfect photos of celebrities, even young people have started buying anti-aging products, which has made the anti-aging industry thrive.
1.explanation_zh: 「看到明星完美的照片」主詞和主要子句相同（年輕人），用分詞構句 Seeing… 開頭；「開始」是到現在的變化，用現在完成式 have started；「這讓抗老產業蓬勃發展」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 which has made… thrive（也可寫 boom／flourish）。

2.translation: Worried about looking old, many consumers spend a lot of money on these products but never stop to think about whether they really work.
2.explanation_zh: 「擔心自己顯老」主詞同為消費者，用過去分詞構句 Worried about looking old；「花大錢買」用 spend a lot of money on；「卻從不想想」用 but never stop to think about；「是否真的有效」用 whether 名詞子句，work 表示有效（也可寫 are really effective）。

issues_zh: 盲譯把「蓬勃發展」譯成 thrive（which has made the anti-aging industry thrive），這是「蓬勃發展」最常見的譯法之一，但第 4 部分 accepted 只收 boom 系列（to boom／boom／a boom in），標的詞彙 boom 也沒有 alternatives；建議 boom 補 thrive、flourish、prosper 等 alternatives，第 4 部分 accepted 補 the anti-aging industry thrive／flourish。
第 3 部分「這讓」只收 which 關係子句；句尾分詞 , causing the anti-aging industry to boom 也是自然正確的寫法（加分寫法也用 fueling a boom），但會被判失分，評分時宜說明 NRREL 是標的句型、分詞寫法另行斟酌。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義

1.translation: After seeing celebrities' perfect photos, even young people have started to buy anti-aging products, which has made the anti-aging industry flourish.
1.explanation_zh: 「連年輕人也」用 even young people 放在主詞；「開始購買」用現在完成式 have started to buy，因為這個趨勢延續到現在；「這讓……蓬勃發展」用非限定的 which 子句接前面整件事，動詞用 has made ... flourish。「看到」改成 After seeing，讓時間先後清楚。

2.translation: Worried about looking old, many consumers spend a lot of money on these products without ever stopping to think about whether they really work.
2.explanation_zh: 「擔心自己顯老」用過去分詞片語 Worried about looking old，主詞是 many consumers，邏輯一致；「卻從不想想」用 without ever stopping to think about whether ...，比用 but 連接兩個動詞更自然；「是否真的有效」用 whether they really work。

issues_zh: 第 1 部分我寫 After seeing（保留連接詞的分詞構句，和本庫 d84c2b 第 2 句把「連接詞＋分詞」算成 PART 的標準一致），但 accepted 只列 Seeing／Having seen，沒有 After seeing。
「蓬勃發展」我譯成 flourish（thrive 也是常見譯法），第 4 部分 accepted 只有 boom，沒有 flourish／thrive；學生寫得正確也可能被判不在可接受範圍，建議補上。
